what_to_detect: The resolution of a persist trigger returns the creature from its owner's graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
near_miss: A creature with persist that dies with a -1/-1 counter on it and stays in the graveyard.
record_fields: payload.events zone_change from_zone graveyard to_zone battlefield
acting line keyword name (the acting line of a keyword-derived ability is the keyword's own line, whose script API type is Keyword, so api cannot single the keyword out)
